{"code": "from dateutil import rrule, parser
from datetime import datetime

# Parse the start date-time
start = parser.parse('19970902T090000')

# Create the rruleset
rule_set = rrule.rruleset()

# Add daily occurrences for 7 instances
rule_set.rrule(rrule.rrule(rrule.DAILY, dtstart=start, count=7))

# Exclude weekends (Saturday and Sunday) yearly
exclude_rule = rrule.rrule(rrule.YEARLY, dtstart=start, byweekday=(rrule.SA, rrule.SU))
rule_set.exrule(exclude_rule)

# Generate the list of date-time instances
result = [dt.isoformat() for dt in rule_set]

result"}
